newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: COASTAL EXPANDS WITH TWO TEXTILES BUYS.
newsitem.headline: COASTAL EXPANDS WITH TWO TEXTILES BUYS.

text.p: South African textiles firm Coastal Group Ltd said on Friday it had bought de Nim Textiles Group from Daun et Cie AG for 133 million rand.
Daun et Cie is an investment vehicle for German entrepreneur Claus Daun.

Coastal also said it had bought a further 39 percent of Botswanan firm Algo Spinning and Weaving Mills Ltd for 14 million pula from the Associated Investments and Development Corp. The move takes Coastal's holding in Algo to 77 percent.
"It is expected that these acquisitions will give Coastal an immediate and significant operational capacity," the firm said in a statement.
De Nim specialises in denim and also has a cotton plantation.
Business Report newspaper quoted industry sources as saying Coastal was preparing other buys in South Africa, with Unispin and De Gama tipped as possible acquisition candidates.
In 1995 de Nim posted a net income after tax of 12 million rand while Algo posted 0.6 million rand in the same period.
Coastal is the South African unit of Indonesian clothing group PT Polysindo Eka Perkarsa .
